summary_en: This study tests samuraciclib, a CDK7 inhibitor, in people with resectable, borderline resectable, or locally advanced basal pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Patients take samuraciclib by mouth once a day for 14 days while on study, and treatment continues if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The stated purpose is to evaluate safety and efficacy; a specific primary outcome is not stated, and the study is listed as Phase 1.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa samuraciclib, un inhibidor de CDK7, en personas con adenocarcinoma ductal pancreático basal resecable, limítrofemente resecable o localmente avanzado. Los pacientes toman samuraciclib por vía oral una vez al día durante 14 días mientras están en el estudio, y el tratamiento continúa si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El propósito indicado es evaluar la seguridad y la eficacia; no se indica un desenlace principal específico, y el estudio figura como Fase 1.
who_for: Confirmed pancreatic adenocarcinoma classified as basal (GATA6-negative and HMGA2-positive tumor).
Resectable, borderline resectable, or locally advanced pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with no metastatic disease.
Age 18 or older and able to understand and sign written consent.
Blood counts, kidney function, and liver function within the stated limits.
not_for: Unable to tolerate oral medication, per the principal investigator.
Active infection, uncontrolled illness, or known active hepatitis B or C.
